activity_summary: On the way up to the Theatre you said your name is on two poems and a tax, and not on a play. Then you asked whose the plays are: the stationer's, the clown's, the boy's who says them.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the memo and walked on.

entities.name: The True Tragedie of Richard Duke of Yorke
entities.context: Mentioned in Whose are they, then

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: My name on two poems and a tax. Not on a play.
